decisions.reason: The cleaning soap draws directly on the firm's surface-treatment knowledge and complements its wood floors, so the firm can interpret market feedback and refine it cheaply.
The maintenance oil line builds on the firm's in-house finishing R&D and strengthens aftersales ties with installers and homeowners, which gives it high absorptive fit.
Care products for oiled floors match the firm's own oiled finishes, so existing know-how lets it assimilate customer feedback and improve the line.

The moisture-protection underlay is a sensible system accessory supported by the firm's installation guidance, though it lies further from its core wood-processing knowledge, much like the withdrawn foam underlay.
Oak parquet sits at the core of the firm's wood-processing expertise and production base, where its capacity to learn and improve is strongest.
